ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 92% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to localized linear disruptions and terminal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black field across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity white pixel clusters are mapped to the distal tips. A network of high-contrast linear white pixels is distributed non-uniformly, with higher density on the right lobe (image-right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 68 degrees, extending deeply toward the fluke-peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge boundary. Observed high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks punctuated by a single deep, irregular notch-like recession on the inner-left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity white pixels forming circular and semi-circular motifs at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of intersecting and parallel high-contrast linear pixel paths (rake marks) across the central and right lobe ventral surfaces, breaking the primary black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular jagged loss of tissue along the trailing edge boundary of the left lobe, adjacent to the median notch, and extensive multi-directional linear rake marks across the fluke plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric jagged protrusion on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately halfway between the median notch and the distal tip.
